  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    payload = case['payload']
    threshold = payload['threshold']
    calls = payload['calls']
    diagnostics = []
    accepted = []
    for call in calls:
        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / tokens
        rounded_gain = round(normalized_gain, 8)
        is_accepted = parseable and rounded_gain >= threshold
        if is_accepted:
            accepted.append(call['call_id'])
        diagnostics.append({
            'call_id': call['call_id'],
            'normalized_gain': rounded_gain,
            'parseable': parseable,
            'accepted': is_accepted
        })
    aggregate = {
        'total_calls': len(calls),
        'accepted_count': len(accepted),
        'threshold': threshold
    }
    return {
        'accepted_call_ids': accepted,
        'diagnostics': diagnostics,
        'aggregate': aggregate
    }"
}
